import numpy as np
np.random.seed(99)

# Generate G(200, 0.3) with seed=99
n = 200
p = 0.3
edges = []
adj_matrix = np.zeros((n, n))

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        if np.random.random() < p:
            edges.append((i, j))
            adj_matrix[i][j] = 1
            adj_matrix[j][i] = 1

# Start with a random partition
partition = np.random.randint(0, 2, n)

# Local search improvement
improved = True
while improved:
    improved = False
    for v in range(n):
        # Calculate current contribution
        current_cut = 0
        for u in range(n):
            if adj_matrix[v][u] == 1 and partition[v] != partition[u]:
                current_cut += 1
        
        # Calculate contribution if we flip vertex v
        flipped_cut = 0
        for u in range(n):
            if adj_matrix[v][u] == 1 and partition[v] == partition[u]:
                flipped_cut += 1
        
        # If flipping improves the cut, do it
        if flipped_cut > current_cut:
            partition[v] = 1 - partition[v]
            improved = True
